THE ROLE AMD HR is seeking an experienced HR Project Manager, M&A and HR Strategic Projects, to drive high-impact initiatives that advance enterprise priorities, accelerate operational transformation, and support mergers and acquisitions integration. This individual contributor role combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution, partnering across HR and the business to translate priorities into actionable plans and scalable solutions that strengthen HR effectiveness. As a member of the HR M&A team, you will play a critical role in supporting acquisitions through pre-close planning, Day 1 readiness, and post-close stabilization, helping ensure a seamless employee transition into AMD. Working closely with senior HR and business leaders, you will influence outcomes, improve processes, and provide executive-ready insights that drive informed decision-making and measurable business results. THE PERSON You are a structured problem solver and collaborative HR professional who thrives in dynamic, fast-paced environments. You bring strong business acumen, sound judgment, and the ability to connect enterprise priorities with practical execution. Skilled at building trusted partnerships, you can influence stakeholders across functions and levels while navigating ambiguity and competing priorities. You are equally comfortable shaping strategy and developing the deliverables needed to achieve results, taking ownership from planning through implementation. With strong communication skills and executive presence, you excel at synthesizing complex information, anticipating risks, and driving alignment across global, matrixed teams. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Partner with HR and business stakeholders to assess complex business challenges, align cross-functional priorities, and develop practical, scalable solutions that support strategic HR initiatives and M&A integration outcomes. Manage and coordinate HR M&A integration activities across pre-close planning, Day 1 readiness, post-close execution, and stabilization efforts. Develop and maintain integration plans, project trackers, governance materials, executive updates, and key deliverables to ensure alignment, visibility, and successful execution across concurrent initiatives. Drive post-close stabilization programs and priority integration activities in partnership with M&A leadership and HR functional teams. Implement process improvement initiatives that simplify operations, strengthen controls, and identify opportunities for system enhancements and AI-enabled ways of working. Design and execute project and deployment plans with clear governance, change management strategies, milestones, and measurable success criteria. Prepare concise, executive-ready communications that provide visibility into progress, risks, dependencies, decisions, and business outcomes. PREFERRED EXPERIENCE Experience leading global HR programs, strategic initiatives, organizational transformation efforts, and change management programs. Strong business acumen with the ability to quickly understand new businesses, operating models, and HR environments. Expertise in program and project management, including prioritization, dependency management, and execution of complex initiatives. Experience influencing stakeholders and driving adoption across multicultural, cross-functional, and globally matrixed organizations. Proficiency leveraging Microsoft Office applications, AI-enabled tools, and other technologies to create executive communications, project analyses, and decision-ready materials. Experience facilitating process improvements and driving recommendations through implementation. jobs.title: Sr. Manager, AI Strategy & Solutions
jobs.description: WHAT YOU DO AT AMD CHANGES EVERYTHING At AMD, our mission is to build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences—from AI and data centers, to PCs, gaming and embedded systems. Grounded in a culture of innovation and collaboration, we believe real progress comes from bold ideas, human ingenuity and a shared passion to create something extraordinary. When you join AMD, you’ll discover the real differentiator is our culture. We push the limits of innovation to solve the world’s most important challenges—striving for execution excellence, while being direct, humble, collaborative, and inclusive of diverse perspectives. Join us as we shape the future of AI and beyond. Together, we advance your career. The Role: AMD is building the foundations for the next era of Personal AI – intelligence that runs with people rather than in a distant datacenter, across PCs and personal devices that people use every day. As the Sr. Manager, AI Strategy & Solutions within the Client and Graphics (CG) business unit, you will define AMD’s long-term view of where Personal AI is heading, incubating the technology and business initiatives that position AMD ahead of those shifts, and establish the early partnerships that shape emerging AI ecosystems around AMD’s value proposition. This is a core leadership role engaging directly with strategic customers, ecosystem partners and early start ups, as well as internal AMD teams and subject matter experts. Based on these engagements, you will drive the strategy on where Personal AI is heading and translate it into the priorities that shape AMD’s investment and product roadmap. The Person: The successful candidate is A technologist with genuine depth in AI and consumer usecases, with a concrete understanding of AI technologies, inference needs and AI platform tradeoffs. Has a proven track record of originating strategic initiatives, building the case behind them, securing investment and carrying them through to a measurable outcome. A systems thinker with strong ecosystem instincts, at ease across silicon, software, models, applications and partners, and able to recognize where the industry is heading early. Brings exceptional executive communication and influence skills, with the ability to engage effectively across a wide range of stakeholders. Key Responsibilities: Define, own and evolve AMD’s long-term view of where Personal AI is heading and translate that view into priorities that will strengthen competitive positioning, establish long-term thought leadership and favorably position AMD in the emerging AI ecosystems. Incubate the strategic technology and business initiatives that position AMD ahead of emerging shifts — building the technical and business case behind each, securing investment, and carrying it through to a measurable outcome. Establish early partnerships with AI model providers, application developers, framework and runtime owners, and startups that shape emerging AI ecosystems around AMD's value proposition. Bring clear, data-backed recommendations to CG and AMD executive leadership, and represent AMD credibly with strategic customers, partner executives and technical leaders. Required Experience Recent depth in AI. Experience in technology product management, business development, architecture, corporate strategy and engineering leadership, including direct ownership of a product, platform or partnership outcome. Depth in the Personal AI ecosystem — models, consumer-facing applications, developer frameworks, on-device and hybrid inference — ideally gained at an AI model provider, a consumer AI application company, or a platform or silicon company driving AI technology strategy. Experience shaping silicon, platform or software roadmaps based on real workload, ecosystem and partner requirements, with familiarity across personal computing platforms and the OEM, ISV and operating system ecosystems surrounding them. A record of building strategic relationships that produced measurable results — with customers, ecosystem partners or early-stage companies Experience defining and influencing multi‑year strategies, balancing near‑term execution with long‑term vision. Onsite Leadership: Lead the onsite operational command structure for assigned events, coordinating teams and resources and providing senior decision-making and escalation leadership in live environments. Operational Expertise & Continuous Improvement: Serve as a senior subject-matter expert within Event Operations, identifying new approaches, contributing to operational standards and best practices, and applying lessons from complex programs across the broader portfolio. Team Development & Mentorship: Provide program-level leadership, coaching, and mentorship to Event Operations Leads, Managers, and Coordinators, helping strengthen operational capability across the organization without direct people management responsibility. PREFERRED EXPERIENCE: Extensive progressive experience in event operations, event production, experiential marketing, or related disciplines, including leadership of large-scale, complex, and high-profile events. Demonstrated experience serving as the senior operational lead for major conferences, flagship events, or similarly complex live experiences. Deep expertise across venue operations, production integration, registration, attendee flow, staffing, F&B, security, transportation, logistics, and onsite event management. Experience developing operating models for complex or evolving programs where established approaches may not exist. Demonstrated experience managing significant event budgets and making complex scope, resource, and investment tradeoffs. Extensive experience leading agencies, production partners, venues, vendors, and large cross-functional delivery teams. Demonstrated ability to anticipate and manage significant operational risk and make sound decisions in complex live-event environments. Strong executive presence with demonstrated ability to advise senior stakeholders on operational implications, tradeoffs, risks, and recommendations. Demonstrated ability to lead through influence and provide direction to cross-functional teams without direct people management authority. Strong financial acumen, sound judgment, communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills. Define where AI belongs in a dashboard—summarization, anomaly surfacing, natural-language query—and where it does not. jobs.title: Strategic Sourcing Manager
jobs.description: ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD. At AMD, we believe technology can change lives for the better. It can heal us, entertain us, and make us more connected, productive, and understanding of the world around us. And we’re looking for talent who feel the same: people who want to leave the planet better than they found it, those who don’t shy away from humanity’s challenges but are determined to help solve them. AMD is powering the next generation of supercomputing, high-performance computing, cloud, and AI. Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or creating go-to-market plans, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. THE ROLE: We are seeking a Procurement Strategic Sourcing Manager based in Secaucus, NJ, or Austin, TX, to lead NPI procurement activities for sheet metal mechanical components. In this role, you will serve as the project procurement manager, connecting key MECH suppliers with engineering teams to support critical procurement activities across major design milestones. You will work in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment, partnering closely with engineering, planning, and procurement teams to keep projects on schedule and support time-to-market goals. This opportunity will allow you to strengthen your vendor management expertise while contributing directly to successful new product introductions and risk mitigation across a complex, dynamic supply chain. If you enjoy hands-on supplier engagement, technical negotiations, and execution-focused project management, this role is for you. THE PERSON: You are a detail-oriented and highly organized professional with deep supplier management experience and strong knowledge of mechanical components. You proactively manage schedule changes based on design status and project timelines, coordinating closely with suppliers, demand planning, and engineering teams to secure project schedules, reduce shortages and excess inventory, and mitigate supply chain risks. You are skilled at tracking BOMs and part numbers, releasing forecasts and demand orders, and negotiating delivery schedules with confidence. With a collaborative mindset and strong execution focus, you help drive alignment and clear communication in a deadline-driven, cross-functional environment. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: Demonstrate knowledge of BOM structure and design processes in server and rack environments. Demonstrate understanding of mechanical manufacturing process, such as sheet metal, die casting, plastic injection mold, CNC, NCT, MIM, and etc. Demonstrate the knowledge of NPI process for server product segment. Utilize advanced analytical and communication skills to support cross-functional collaboration and problem-solving. Manage multiple priorities effectively, demonstrating expert multitasking and time management abilities. Apply proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills, to support data analysis and presentations. Plan and organize activities using structured tracking tools to ensure project progress and accountability. Take proactive ownership of issues, driving timely resolution and follow-through until completion. Collaborate effectively across teams and departments to achieve company goals and deliver results. PREFERRED EXPERIENCE: Proven Industry experience in the ODM/OEM Manufacturing or Server System Solution industry. Direct experience in supply chain function is a plus. Experience using Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, including but not limited to the ability to analyze data using pivots and V-Lookups. Proficiency in English and bilingual in Mandarin preferred. Proficiency in procurement and supply chain principles and skills. ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS: Bachelor’s Degree in Business/Industrial Engineering Management/Technology Administration, Supply Chain Management or related field. LOCATION: AMD Secaucus, NJ, or Austin, TX. #LI-AJ1 Benefits offered are described: AMD benefits at a glance. Lead major negotiations end to end: renewals, enterprise agreements, license buy-outs, statements of work and assignment or novation terms arising from acquisitions and divestitures. Build the quantitative case behind each position, including normalized cost-per-capacity benchmarks, total cost of ownership comparisons across competing suppliers, and royalty or consumption models over the life of a program. Own third-party IP contracting on behalf of the company: aggregate requirements across business units, establish a repeatable intake and approval process, and hold the commercial relationship rather than joining late as a signatory. Ensure every major transaction clears its governance path before signature: thresholds, technical accounting review, internal controls and required approvals are complete first, with no exceptions made under schedule pressure. Partner with Engineering, Finance, Legal and IT to set cost targets, plan capacity and license requirements ahead of demand, and align procurement timing with program milestones and license expirations. Prepare and deliver executive-level material: negotiation positions, capital and expense review board submissions, savings and risk reporting, and clear recommendations that a senior audience can act on quickly. Commercial fluency with licensing constructs: enterprise agreements, royalties, capacity and subscription pricing, buy-outs, assignment and novation, and consumption-based terms. You will conduct site security audits and due diligence assessments of suppliers, manufacturing partners, and logistics providers; investigate product loss, theft, and diversion; and help ensure that high-value AI accelerators, GPUs, CPUs, and other AMD products are secured from the point of manufacture through authorized distribution. You will work in a fast-paced, global environment where your investigative, analytical, and cross-functional partnership skills will play a direct role in protecting AMD’s brand, revenue, and reputation. This newly created role supports AMD’s continued growth in high-value AI and data center products and the ongoing maturation of its global supply chain security program. The successful candidate will bring current, modern investigative practices to help strengthen and evolve how AMD protects its most valuable and sought-after AI products. THE PERSON Insatiable curiosity and a passion for uncovering facts and following them wherever they lead, along with sound judgment about when and how to escalate. Ability to build trust and credibility across a global, cross-functional organization, including with external partners, suppliers, and law enforcement. Strong analytical and reporting skills, with the ability to translate complex findings into clear, defensible documentation for leadership. Comfortable operating independently across time zones and cultures, with sensitivity to local laws, customs, and labor practices during site visits and audits. Creative, practical problem-solver who can balance risk mitigation with business continuity. Collaborative, can-do colleague who communicates with discretion and professionalism, especially when handling sensitive or confidential matters. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Conduct on-site and virtual security audits and due diligence assessments of suppliers, manufacturing sites, and third-party logistics (3PL) facilities to ensure the secure handling, storage, warehousing, distribution, and reclamation of AMD products. Investigate incidents of product theft, loss, diversion, and counterfeiting, partnering with Global Product Investigations and regional security teams across the Americas, EMEA, Asia Pacific, and Greater China, as needed. Perform open-source intelligence (OSINT) research and due diligence on new and existing supply chain partners to identify security, integrity, and reputational risks. Support compliance with the Customs-Trade Partnership Against Terrorism (C-TPAT) and other trade security programs across AMD sites, product storage facilities, and cross-dock facilities. Prepare clear, accurate, and well-documented investigation reports and audit findings, including recommended corrective and remediation actions, for leadership review. Partner cross-functionally with Legal, Global Trade, Procurement, Information Security, and business unit teams to assess and mitigate third-party and supply chain risks in accordance with AMD’s Third-Party Risk Management standards. Support the security of high-value, high-demand AI infrastructure products, including accelerators, GPUs, and CPUs, as they move through manufacturing, assembly, testing, and distribution. Track corrective action plans following audits or incidents and follow up to confirm timely closure. Respond to and help coordinate on-site theft, loss, and other security incidents reported through regional security channels. Contribute to the continuous improvement of AMD’s supply chain security program, policies, and audit methodology. PREFERRED EXPERIENCE Five or more years of experience in corporate investigations, supply chain security, loss prevention, or related risk or security roles. Experience in the technology, semiconductor, or high-value manufacturing industry is a plus. Experience with global logistics and trade security frameworks, such as C-TPAT and TAPA, is a plus. Experience conducting supplier or third-party due diligence and site security assessments. Willingness and ability to travel internationally to supplier, manufacturing, and logistics sites as needed. Knowledge of state-of-the-art investigative practices, supported by recent, hands-on experience with real-world cases rather than reliance on legacy methods or outdated tools. Strong understanding of evolving technology risks, including how digital, cyber, and physical threats intersect across a global supply chain. Demonstrated ability to identify, assess, and respond to increasingly sophisticated threats targeting AI technology and intellectual property, including nation-state, insider, and organized theft schemes targeting high-value computing and accelerator products. ACADEMIC AND PROFESSIONAL CREDENTIALS Bachelor’s degree in security management, criminal justice, business, or a related field, or equivalent experience. The Strategic Sourcing Manager will be responsible for supplier quotations and negotiations, costed BOM management, NPI development costs, material readiness, forecast and demand execution, and supply-chain risk mitigation. THE PERSON: The ideal candidate is a proactive, detail-oriented sourcing and supply-chain professional with experience supporting cable products used in server and rack systems. You have a strong understanding of BOM structures, product design milestones, NPI processes, supplier management, procurement principles, and material planning. Evaluate supplier quotations and negotiate pricing, development costs, change-related expenses, material commitments, and delivery schedules. Develop and maintain effective working relationships with cable suppliers to support sourcing, product development, and supply continuity objectives. Track and manage cable-related BOMs, part numbers, supplier information, costs, and change histories throughout each milestone of the product design lifecycle. Partner with engineering teams and cable suppliers to understand design requirements, identify sourcing dependencies, and support the timely execution of NPI activities. Monitor raw-material readiness with suppliers and maintain clear, well-structured trackers for material status, shortages, risks, actions, owners, and recovery dates. Identify, track, and report critical material shortages and coordinate with suppliers and cross-functional teams to expedite raw materials and improve delivery schedules. Release cable-related forecasts and demand orders to suppliers and negotiate supply commitments to support required production and material delivery schedules. Work with suppliers, engineers, procurement, and supply-chain teams to develop and execute material-readiness and supply-risk mitigation plans. Proactively identify potential continuity, capacity, lead-time, quality, cost, and delivery risks and drive corrective actions through resolution. Manage material readiness in a manner that supports supply continuity while reducing excess and obsolete inventory exposure. Use analytical tools and supply-chain data to evaluate forecasts, demand requirements, supplier performance, material readiness, and sourcing risks. Communicate status, priorities, issues, and recommended actions clearly and accurately to suppliers and internal stakeholders. Demonstrate strong planning and organizational skills by maintaining accurate sourcing and material-readiness trackers. Manage multiple projects and competing priorities in a fast-paced product development and supply-chain environment. Take accountability for assigned actions and proactively drive issues to timely resolution. Collaborate effectively across organizations to achieve sourcing, supply-chain, and company objectives. Maintain a strong focus on results, information accuracy, and attention to detail PREFERRED EXPERIENCE: Experience in strategic sourcing, procurement, supply planning, supplier management, or a related supply-chain function. Industry experience within ODM/OEM manufacturing, server system solutions, rack-level infrastructure, electronics, cables, or a related technology manufacturing environment. Experience managing supplier RFQs, costed BOMs, NPI development expenses, forecasts, purchase or demand releases, and delivery commitments. Knowledge of cable products, BOM structures, part number management, product design processes, and engineering change activities for server or rack systems. Experience monitoring supplier material readiness, identifying material shortages, expediting deliveries, and developing supply-risk mitigation plans. Understanding of excess and obsolete inventory risk and the relationship between forecasts, demand changes, supplier commitments, and material procurement. Advanced analytical, problem-solving, communication, negotiation, multitasking, and prioritization skills. Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and PowerPoint. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including experience analyzing data using PivotTables, VLOOKUP or comparable lookup functions, formulas, filters, and structured trackers.
